name: 炼金置物架 8
prompt:
生成8个魔法炼金工坊用深色木制开放置物架变体。所有变体必须使用完全相同的主体、尺寸、层板结构、深色木纹风格和轮廓，结构与开放书架类似，仅改变内容物。每个置物架内容物占可用层板空间30%-70%，分布疏密自然并保留空层板区域。内容物主要为精细炼金器具、玻璃瓶、陶罐、带塞试管、烧瓶、研钵、漏斗、小天平、材料袋、矿物盒、草药束和少量标签瓶；8个变体必须具有不同的器具与材料组合，不得只是换色。瓶罐尺寸有层次但摆放稳定，不悬空，不生成液体特效。普通材质base或vertex color只能从以下色卡选取：#FFFDF6,#FEF9EA,#FDF2D7,#E9DABD,#CDBA97,#F8E8CF,#F1D7B2,#E7C393,#C9A06E,#9E7A55,#FFF7A8,#FCEF72,#F6E24B,#D1B825,#9C8510,#FFF3B7,#FDE674,#FCD75F,#FECD4D,#D1900B,#FFE2A0,#FFD170,#F8BC44,#E39F1A,#A96F05,#FBE3BD,#FDD8A3,#FDCC8F,#F1AD69,#D99256,#FFD2BA,#F
Coordinate contract: local Y+ is up, local Z+ is the front, entrance, or forward direction, and local X+ is right. Put doors, facades, openings, windshields, noses, seats, and other recognizable front details toward local Z+. For a modular repeated element, explicitly choose the long axis: side-by-side modules span local X with depth/front on local Z; traversal modules span local Z. Keep the model centered at its origin.
Canonical dimensions contract: width=1.55, height=2.75, depth=0.5 world units. Keep the generated mesh within this centered bounding size.
Create variation 8 of 8; preserve the same reusable asset family while varying silhouette and details.
